title: Effective Study Techniques
summary: Research-backed study techniques include active recall (testing yourself), spaced repetition (reviewing over days), interleaving topics and teaching the material to someone else. Rereading and highlighting are less effective.
answer_guidance: Explain clearly and simply in the user's language; give steps or examples when the user asks how.
